Green. 625/625.

3 failures, one bug: `orderTotal` taxed pre-discount base.

`src/pricing.js:41`
```js
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);      // before
const tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate); // after
```

Doc comment above already said tax goes on the discounted amount — code contradicted it. Only cases with both non-zero discount and non-zero tax failed, which is why 0%-off rows passed.
